reverse_charge.note: §13b (Leistungsempfänger als Steuerschuldner) is the CURRENT reverse-charge article. The UStG was restructured: the old §3g (cross-border services reverse charge) is now the gas/electricity/heating/cooling place-of-supply rule (dejure.org, 2026-10-09). The buyer bears the VAT debt; the buyer's USt-IdNr. is mandatory. §13b is services only — a goods supply with a buyer USt-IdNr. uses §4a, not reverse charge. Residual uncertainty: whether the cross-border SERVICES reverse charge sits in §13b or another article is unverified (dejure.org text is JS-rendered); confirm with the tax advisor. Re-verified 2026-10-14: dejure.org returns HTTP 200 but the statute text is JS-rendered (empty curl body); the §13b renumbering remains unverified — tax advisor must confirm.
reverse_charge.reverify_note: Re-verified 2026-10-15 (PASS 5): primary source re-fetched, see config/REVERIFY_2026-10-15.md.
